question.question: Does Config.Clone, as consumed by RawNode.Status, preserve the AutoLeave mode of an actually installed implicit joint configuration?
question.importance: Incorrect configuration status can mislead callers about whether Raft or the application owns exit from joint authority. No active quorum or log corruption is presumed.
contexts: Serialized observation immediately after applying a committed implicit joint configuration and before its Ready is advanced
Explicit joint configuration as false-mode control

question.trigger_rationale: Clone promises a copy but its returned literal lists all map fields and omits AutoLeave; getStatus consumes that clone unchanged. Earlier execution exposed a live/exported difference, but a separate fixed check must establish this copy obligation under its own legal producer history. A small status observation at application suffices; no further transfer variants or lengthy schedule is needed.

obligation.description: A Config copy returned through RawNode.Status must preserve the currently installed configuration AutoLeave value, including true for implicit joint mode, while being separate from the live configuration.

scope.description: Value preservation of installed automatic-exit mode when RawNode.Status copies tracker.Config at a serialized observation point.
assumptions: Caller uses legal bootstrap/election/committed configuration application and observes without concurrent protocol mutation.
excluded: No claim about active-state mutation, consensus safety, external application use of Status or unobserved downstream consequences.
Map isolation and preservation of other fields are not separate checked requirements.

grounding.derivation: Clone explicitly returns a copy of Config, which includes the semantic AutoLeave field. RawNode.Status promises current group status and getStatus assigns Clone to Status.Config. No documented redaction or special reinterpretation of AutoLeave is present. Implicit mode is established by EnterJoint after a committed entry is applied. The requirement is equality of the copied field at this serialized call, not a global protocol outcome.
grounding.applicability: Actual installed implicit or explicit joint state; source and result refer to the same node/configuration application with no intervening transition.
alternatives: Map fields are copied and active mode remains correct; these facts limit consequence but do not satisfy scalar value preservation.
